name: manager_invariants
description: CROSS-MANAGER CONSISTENCY (E2E_PLAN g2). Drives focus + scroll so the focus/scroll/hover managers actually hold keys, then sweeps them: X10 (no manager key may name a node that no longer exists in layout_results), X2 (has_active_animations() <=> some AnimatedScrollState carries an animation), X3 (an active drag agrees with the hit-test DOM), X5 (a multi-cursor anchor whose node vanished must have been cleared), X6 (multi_cursor => focus is set and live), X9 (scrollbar_fade_active needs a registered scroll node). Then DELETES a node mid-flight and re-sweeps: the managers must not be left holding a key into the removed subtree. FAILURE INJECTION EVIDENCE: making node_is_live() ignore layout_results (always false) turns the sweep red with 'X10 scroll: state key (0, N) points at a node that no longer exists'. The four OPT-IN invariants (X1, X4, X7, X8) are deliberately absent from the lists below: each is a statement about an interaction this scenario does not perform, and each hard-fails when asked without its subject rather than passing on an empty premise — asking for X4 here would (correctly) report that no drag is active.
